title: Lumen Reef
blurb: A falling-block puzzle in the midnight zone. Stack glowing coral and every full line rises as a plankton bloom.
description: A falling-block puzzle a thousand metres down. Seven species of bioluminescent coral drift into the well; fill whole rows and they dissolve into plankton blooms that rise out of the dark. Clear four at once and a whale glides past. Every ten lines takes you 250 metres deeper, where the water darkens, the coral glows brighter and the sonar pulse quickens. Modern rules (seven-piece bags, hold, ghost, wall kicks, lock delay and T-spins) with an endless marathon and a 40-line sprint.
